name: Nightmarish Mind
body:
Your connection with the Goddess of Nightmares grants you immunity or resistance to fear and madness.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a god of nightmares

Benefit: You are immune to all non-magical fear effects and receive a +2 divine bonus to saving throws versus magical fear effects, or versus spells that cause madness or insanity.
